content:
The 62nd annual L&F Christmas Parade will look a little different this year. Organizers have changed the downtown route following the DoubleTree fire, moving the parade's finish away from the damaged hotel area, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The parade is set for Saturday, Dec. 12, starting at noon at the Gateway Shopping Center and traveling through downtown Laredo. Instead of ending at Garden Street, as originally planned, the procession will now end at the intersection of Alamo Street and San Bernardo Street, keeping participants and spectators clear of the fire-affected area.

More than 180 floats are expected, and the musical group Siggno has been named grand marshal. The route change is a safety adjustment, not a cancellation: the tradition goes on, just on a path that works around a downtown still dealing with the aftermath of the Oct. 7 DoubleTree fire, which remains an active investigation and stabilization site.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, “L&F Christmas Parade changes downtown route following DoubleTree fire,” Oct. 2026.

title: L&F Christmas Parade changes downtown route after DoubleTree fire
